headline: As of 2026-10-15: 5,479,366 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 37 of 50 states, D+21.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 5,479,366 early/mail ballots cast so far across 37 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+21.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Florida (670,047), California (594,007), Michigan (573,306).
